_doc: The contest registry (docs/designs/contest-finder.md, Discovery). One entry per contest, read by a person from the organiser's own page on the date in `read`. Field meanings: group photo|app-award|pitch|grant|academic-award; size large|small (odds prior); deadline_status verified|expected|rolling|unknown (only verified deadlines are picked); fee_usd is the total for the planned entry (`images` photos), null when unknown; prize_usd is the top cash prize, category_prize_usd one category win, prize_goods_usd non-cash; licence_text, eligibility_text, ai_text, automation_text are short paraphrases of the rules (trigger words kept) used when the page cannot be read; taken_from/taken_to bound capture dates; allow_rights true lifts the rights gate for one contest (Ben's call). Entries and refusals are Ben's private record: they live in the ledger (contests.py mark), never here.

contests.name: Sony World Photography Awards Single Image competition
contests.fee_text: free for up to 3 images; bundles for more
contests.prize_text: $5,000 overall winner plus Sony equipment; category winners get equipment
contests.eligibility_text: Rules 1.2.2: open to all members of the public. Images must be taken in 2026.
contests.ai_text: Manipulation is allowed but its extent must be described; computer generated content cannot be the origin of an entry.
contests.licence_text: 7.1 The author keeps copyright in each Entry. 7.2 The author grants WPO and its Event Partners a non-exclusive, irrevocable licence to use any image submitted to the competition throughout the world for three years after the announcement in April 2027, in all media, for promotion, including: (a) judging; (b) exhibitions of winners; (c) website, book or magazine; (d) promotional materials; (e) competition-related products sold by WPO or a third party following the individual agreement by the author; (f) sub-licensing to the press in connection with the competition; (g) personal viewing by app users; (h) galleries on Event Partner devices, where an included image will remain perpetually in the device royalty free.
contests.notes: The reference case for the rights flagger: the grant covers every entry, and 7.2(h) is perpetual.

contests.name: Wildlife Photographer of the Year 63
contests.fee_text: GBP 35 once, for up to 25 photos
contests.prize_text: Grand title about GBP 10,000 (amounts for 63 not published; recently increased); category winners about GBP 1,000
contests.eligibility_text: Open to adults worldwide. Photos taken on or after 1 November 2021.
contests.ai_text: Sharpening, noise reduction and tone changes are allowed; AI-generated images, composites and adding or removing elements are not; do not upscale.
contests.licence_text: Copyright stays with the entrant. Entries may be reproduced for judging and public voting. Winning and finalist images grant the museum use in any medium for five years (seven for print) for the competition and exhibition.
contests.notes: Pure landscape has no category; Plants and Fungi, Wetlands and Natural Artistry fit the library best.

contests.name: Monochrome Photography Awards 2026
contests.prize_text: $2,000 Professional Photographer of the Year; title awards per category
contests.eligibility_text: Open to photographers aged 18 or over, any country. Black-and-white images only.
contests.licence_text: Copyright stays with the photographer. Entrants grant a non-exclusive, irrevocable licence in each Entry throughout the world in all media for use in connection with the competition. Images are not resold.
contests.notes: Colour originals: the prefill copies are converted to greyscale for review; Ben should make his own black-and-white conversion before entering.

contests.name: The Nature Photography Contest 2026
contests.prize_text: EUR 1,000 Photograph of the Year; EUR 100 per category winner (10 categories)
contests.eligibility_text: Open worldwide to amateurs and professionals. Images already awarded in other contests are excluded.
contests.ai_text: Images must be of 100% photographic origin; digital art is rejected. AI is not named.
contests.licence_text: Copyright stays with the photographer. Winning images grant the contest unlimited non-exclusive use for the contest. The associated company 3lens gets a non-exclusive, perpetual and royalty-free right for biodiversity promotion of winning images; economic exploitation is prohibited.
contests.notes: The homepage once said the deadline was extended to 25 November; the rules say 15 November. Use 15 November.

contests.name: BigPicture Natural World Photography Competition 2027
contests.fee_text: $25 for up to 10 single images (2026 edition)
contests.ai_text: No stitched panoramas, HDR or cloning; noise reduction allowed; nothing that adds content via AI (2026 rules).
contests.licence_text: Entrants keep ownership. All entrants grant a non-exclusive, irrevocable license to publish images related to the competition in perpetuity, including exhibition merchandising; other commercial use needs permission.
contests.notes: 2027 rules not posted on 2026-11-02; dates extrapolated from 2026.

contests.name: International Photography Awards 2027
contests.eligibility_text: Age 18 or over, any country. Anyone with published work enters as a professional. Photos no more than 5 years old.
contests.licence_text: Copyright stays with the photographer. IPA may use any entry for marketing and promotion, including exhibitions, without payment.

contests.name: 35AWARDS
contests.prize_text: no cash: top-100 lists, diplomas, a catalogue
contests.ai_text: AI-generated content is banned outside the AI category; AI enhancement beyond standard correction, AI noise reduction and upscaling are banned.
contests.licence_text: Photos remain the author's copyright. By submitting photos, authors grant the organizers permission to use the provided materials for any purpose related to the competition and subsequent exhibitions, and agree to publication in a catalog, contest exhibitions and other post-competition events without any monetary compensation.

contests.name: Siena International Photo Awards 2027
contests.ai_text: Editing with the use of AI algorithms is barred (2026 rules).

contests.name: CEWE Photo Award 2027
contests.prize_text: over 1000 prizes in goods and vouchers (1st: a EUR 10,000 trip plus EUR 7,500 in vouchers); no cash
contests.notes: Terms read 2026-11-02 in a browser (the page is rendered by JavaScript). Clause 7.2 says 31 May 2026, a leftover; clause 4.0 gives 31 May 2027.
contests.eligibility_text: Natural persons aged 18 or over may enter; no country restriction is stated. A user account is required.
contests.ai_text: Photos must be taken with a lens-based camera. AI-generated content and generative fills are not permitted; edits must not add or remove information and must be described on submission.
contests.licence_text: CEWE never acquires the copyright. By participating, the entrant grants CEWE and its affiliates an irrevocable, spatially unlimited and perpetual right of use of all submitted photographs for PR work, for non-commercial self-promotion of CEWE, including websites, print, out of home, social networks, exhibitions, charity auctions, press and a CEWE PHOTOBOOK. Any further commercial use requires the separate consent of the participant.

contests.name: ZWO Astronomy Photographer of the Year 2027
contests.licence_text: Non-exclusive licence; ten years of merchandise use for a one-off GBP 50 per image (2026 rules). The organiser prefers images not submitted to picture agencies.
contests.notes: Discourages stock-licensed images: only night-sky frames not on stock.

contests.name: Audubon Photography Awards 2027
contests.eligibility_text: Legal residents of the 50 United States, DC or Canada (excluding Quebec), aged 13 or over. Birds only.

contests.name: Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest
contests.licence_text: Every entrant grants a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to use each entry for any purpose, including commercial products and derivative works (23rd contest rules).
contests.notes: On hiatus after 23 years (banner on the contest page, 2026-11-02). Kept so it is recognised if it returns.

contests.name: Hamdan International Photography Award (HIPA) Water: Our Shared Story
contests.licence_text: Finalists grant a perpetual, sub-licensable, royalty-free licence tied to the competition; winners' licence covers any purpose, including derivatives and promoting HIPA generally.

contests.name: International Landscape Photographer of the Year 2026
contests.organizer: International Landscape Photographer of the Year
contests.licence_text: Promotional use only; non-winners limited to three years.

contests.name: Travel Photographer of the Year 2026
contests.licence_text: Free reproduction and exhibition of entered images in all media for award-related use only; merchandise needs a separate agreement with royalty.
contests.notes: Next edition expected to open around April 2027.

contests.name: Webby Awards (31st)
contests.organizer: International Academy of Digital Arts and Sciences
contests.fee_text: about $525 to $715 per entry at the final deadline
contests.licence_text: Submitting an entry grants the Webbys the right to use it for exhibition, promotion and publication in any medium. Fees are non-refundable.
contests.notes: Final deadline inferred from the 29th and 30th cycles; an extended deadline usually follows in early February.

contests.name: American Business Awards 2027
contests.fee_text: about $265 to $390 per app entry (last cycle)
contests.notes: Early-bird dates 2026-11-18 and 2026-12-17. Terms (rights clause) not read.

contests.name: Apple Design Awards 2027
contests.notes: No entry or nomination process published for 2027; watch Apple Developer news from February.

contests.name: Product Hunt Orbit Awards
contests.notes: Replaces the Golden Kitty Awards. Quarterly, review-driven; no entry form.

contests.name: SXSW Pitch 2027
contests.notes: Two sources disagree (Nov 11 vs Nov 13). Prize amounts not confirmed.

contests.name: TechCrunch Startup Battlefield
contests.notes: Favours venture-backed pre-Series A startups; weak fit.

contests.name: NASE Growth Grants
contests.notes: Quarterly review; Oct to Dec applications reviewed in January 2027. Needs a business plan, a P&L and a photo.

contests.name: Better Scientific Software Fellowship 2027
contests.notes: Paid through the fellow's institution; unclear whether a single-member LLC qualifies. Ben's university role must not be used.

contests.name: Amber Grant
contests.notes: For woman-owned businesses only.

contests.name: FedEx Small Business Grant Contest
contests.notes: Ran 2012 to 2024; retired.

contests.name: ACM Software System Award
contests.notes: Suspended pending review; nominations not accepted.
